items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: Freddie Kepler Was a master During that day

ctx.x: Yeah It was jazz day At that time Sure Buddy Bolden And Freddie Kepler Was a master During that day And Mario Perez Was a top musician And there was a man That day Was a better musician Yet than all of them From the name of James McNeil I think you heard him James McNeil He's a cracker jack And another man Another street man Named George Morett James McNeil Another street man Named Andrew Kimball Another from Alcibiot All those are cracks

items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: But I thought Freddie Kepper was one of the best we had in the business.

ctx.x: Yeah, Joe. Yeah, Joe. Joe played nicely. But I thought Freddie Kepper was one of the best we had in the business. Freddie Kepper.
Did he have as much rhythm as Joe?
